Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images show a fetal chest mass composed of numerous small cystic lesions (microcysts) in the right lung. The color Doppler image demonstrates blood flow within the lesion but lacks the distinct single large systemic feeding vessel characteristic of pulmonary sequestration, making Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM/CPAM) Type II the most consistent diagnosis among the choices provided.
